origin.description: Path to a per-user directory for one package.

arguments.name: which
arguments.text: One of "data", "config", "cache". A unique prefix is accepted.

origin.details: On Unix, data is $XDG_DATA_HOME or ~/.local/share, config is $XDG_CONFIG_HOME or ~/.config, and cache is $XDG_CACHE_HOME or ~/.cache. R_USER_DATA_DIR, R_USER_CONFIG_DIR, and R_USER_CACHE_DIR win when set. The package name is appended under R/.
